title: PowerHaus Can Look
request: Oct 19 2026 11:57 ICT: Max asked for fresh follow-up decks from his Oct 19 WellNest results (20 pairs each, routing to Branding, WellNest dashboard shelf).
example_data: From PowerHaus Collab Look results: spine, wrap band, arcs, matte white, kraft lid with blue band applied to cans; fresh palettes, name type, co-brand badge and drinkware after his rejections.
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind); WellNest DNA inside the mockups
